compatibility.description: p.52 combination matrix row '2MXM40A' shows connectable indoor units (dots) across families: CTXA-AW/BS/BT/BB (15/20/25/35), CTXM-R (15/20/25/35), FTXM-R (15/20/25/35), FTXJ-AW/S/B (20/25/35), FTXP-M9 (20/25/35), FDXM-F9 (25/35), CVXM-A (20/25/35), FVXM-A (25/35), FVXM-F (25/35), FCAG-B (35), FFA-A9 (25/35), FHA-A9 (35/50), FNA-A9 (25/35). NOTE: matrix dots indicate CONNECTABILITY eligibility per Daikin; this is NOT a thermal pairing/rating (p.52 has NO efficiency table). Do not treat as a matched combination for capacity. Blurb: 'Jusqu'à 5 unités intérieures peuvent être connectées à 1 unité extérieure multi'.

evidence.locator: PDF p.52, combination matrix row '2MXM40A' (dot columns across UNITÉS INTÉRIEURES CONNECTABLES)
